shortDescription: An occupied staging transformation blending existing furnishings with curated pieces to create a fresh, cohesive home designed to stand out on the market.
longDescription: For this Gardena home, we transformed the existing spaces through a thoughtful blend of occupied staging and curated additions. Working with select furnishings already in the home, we introduced updated furniture, artwork, textiles, greenery, and décor to create a more cohesive and elevated presentation. Each space was intentionally styled to improve flow, highlight the home’s features, and photograph beautifully while still feeling warm and approachable. The result was a polished, market-ready home designed to help buyers see the property at its full potential.
